scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 4173 --directory dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.format: prettier --write build.mjs src public/*.css public/*.js package.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.format:check: prettier --check build.mjs src public/*.css public/*.js package.json wrangler.jsonc
